title: Attribute or Abstain: Evaluating Evidence-Grounded Retrieval on the Low-Resource African Business Web
abstract: arXiv:2611.19900v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems that research companies are judged by how much they find, yet in markets where public evidence is sparse, a confident answer without support costs more than no answer. We introduce AfriBizClaims, a benchmark of 150 company-research queries across six African markets in English, French and Portuguese, including queries about fictitious companies that a correct system must decline. Each claim a system makes is judged against the page it cites by an AI judge, checked against a second AI judge from another model family and against two human annotators, and abstentions are scored against answerability labels. We compare BM25 over a pooled corpus, standard web retrieval-augmented generation, and a multi-step agent pipeline (Konexium V1), all using the same language model. The two simple baselines are well attributed: 98% of their judged claims are supported by the page they cite, and they decline every field of ever

translated_title: 归因或拒答：在低资源非洲商业网络上评估有证据支撑的检索
translated_abstract: 检索增强式企业研究系统通常以其检索到的信息量来评判，然而在公开证据稀缺的市场中，一个缺乏依据却言之凿凿的回答，其代价远大于不作回答。我们提出了AfriBizClaims，这是一个涵盖六个非洲市场、以英语、法语和葡萄牙语提出的150个企业研究查询组成的基准，其中包含关于虚构公司的查询，正确的系统必须对此拒答。系统做出的每一条论断都由一个AI评判器对照其所引用的页面进行评判，再由来自另一个模型家族的第二个AI评判器以及两名人类标注员进行复核，弃答行为则依据可回答性标签进行评分。我们比较了在合并语料库上运行的BM25、标准的网页检索增强生成（RAG），以及一个多步骤智能体流水线，三者均使用相同的语言模型。两个简单的基线方法归因表现良好：它们被判定的论断中有98%获得了所引用页面的支持，并且它们对所有虚构公司相关查询均予以拒答。
tldr: 该论文提出AfriBizClaims基准，首次系统评估检索增强系统在证据稀缺的非洲低资源商业网络上的证据归因与拒答能力，发现简单的BM25和标准RAG基线在归因上表现出色（98%论断有据可依）并能正确拒答虚构公司查询。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AfriBizClaims, a benchmark for evaluating evidence-grounded attribution and abstention in retrieval-augmented systems on the low-resource African business web, showing that simple baselines like BM25 and standard RAG attribute well (98% of claims supported) and correctly abstain on fictitious company queries.
